text:
Anya: Heads-up — GCP reached out about adding a "mexico-central" marketplace region for us. Need to sync quotas, SKUs, and partner entitlements. Targeting availability before the end of next month.
Carlos: I can take the lead with GCP PM. Do we have expected capacity numbers and GPU types?
Andrew: Asking product — expected baseline QPS: 600 rps, burst to 2k. Models we'll serve are 13B and 70B families, typical sequence lengths ~512.
Maya: For infra, we need to know preferred GPU: A100-80GB or H100. H100s need different node types and may affect lead time. Also: are customers on Dedicated gonna need VPC options immediately?
Anya: Most early customers want Dedicated w/ VPC. For Marketplace listing we need two SKUs: hosted inference (metered token) + dedicated reservation.
Carlos: GCP asked for a quota request payload. I put a draft below — please confirm numbers so I can submit: 
```
{
  "region": "northamerica-mexico-central",
  "resource": "nvidia-gpu",
  "gpu_type": "H100",
  "min_nodes": 6,
  "max_nodes": 20,
  "expected_peak_rps": 2000
}
```
Maya: That H100 min=6 seems optimistic given lead times. Can we do H100 max=12 and fallback to A100 if capacity delayed?
Anya: Yes — plan to request H100 first with an A100 fallback SKU for the marketplace. Carlos, please include fallback line in the request.
Carlos: Will do. Also pinging GCP for quota approval SLA — they said 5–7 business days for standard review, faster with partner channel.
Sam: Legal: we'll need the Marketplace addendum + export control signoff for Mexico. Can you drop the prospective customer list (emails redacted) and use ticket `LEGAL-4382` as the thread for review?
Anya: Copy. I'll attach the anonymized list to LEGAL-4382 today.
Jane: Marketing: if we get approval mid-month we can do a soft joint announcement on the 3rd week. Need partner-approved logo and one co-branded banner.
partner_ops_bot: Checklist created: https://redwood.internal/partnerships/checklists/mktx-gcp-mexico-central — items: quota request, SKU manifest, DPA, export review, infra runbook, pricing table. (ETA auto-reminder in 3 days) :bell:
Andrew: Quick ask for pricing team — we need a proposal for reservation pricing tiers for Mexico region (small/medium/large). Who owns that?
Anya: @Carlos — can you loop in pricing ops or should I?
Carlos: I'll loop in pricing ops today and add their contact to this thread.
Maya: Operational note: please include node AMI build id in the SKU manifest and a compatibility note for quantized 4-bit kernels. 
Sam: Also flag any regulated customer requests — Mexico has data residency asks, so include opt-in for Private deployments.
Anya: Great — next steps: Carlos to submit quota + fallback SKU, Maya to confirm node counts/AMI, Sam to pick up LEGAL-4382 review, Jane to prep draft announcement. We'll reconvene in 48h. :thumbsup:
Carlos: Submitted request to GCP partner channel and included fallback. Request ID: `GCPQ-99321`. Posted ETA 6 business days.
Maya: Noted, I'll validate AMI and reply with final node numbers by EOD tomorrow.
Sam: I'll start legal review today, will update LEGAL-4382 with checklist items.
Jane: Draft banner uploaded to Figma (link in thread).
Anya: Thanks team — saving this thread as the single source for mexico-central marketplace onboarding. Please keep replies here. :eyes:
